title: People Chase A Cheese Down A Hill
description:
The Cooper's Hill Cheese-Rolling and Wake is an annual event held on the Spring Bank Holiday at Cooper's Hill in Brockworth, Gloucestershire, England. A round of Double Gloucester cheese is rolled down a very steep hill (a slope of around 50 percent) and competitors race after it. The cheese has about a one-second head start and can reach high speeds, enough to knock over and injure a spectator. The first person over the finish line wins the cheese, even though it is never actually caught. Its earliest known written record is from 1836, and winners have come from many countries.

Source: Wikipedia, "Cooper's Hill Cheese-Rolling and Wake".

Would you chase the cheese? Tell us in the comments.
